description: Read the crowd parlay (the app’s Heat Check card): the one parlay bettors are on most right now, built in code, 2 to 4 legs on different games at one book, every game still to start, graded by the real Grade whatever the letter is (A to F). It is the crowd’s parlay, not the Doctor’s pick: it is never a Tail post and never on the Doctor’s record (onRecord false). parlay is null when fewer than two picks qualify, a game has started, or it is turned off. Each leg has pick, market, line, oddsAmerican, event, startsAt and heat: distinct people on that pick in the last 24 hours (accounts with it in a synced sportsbook bet or with a finished Grade of a slip carrying it; never who, and a pick needs 3). heat.bettors is distinct people on any of the legs, each person once. locked true (no Doctor’s Picks access) leaves legs null. To put it on the slip, send each leg’s selectionId as marketSelectionId with its eventId, the parlay bookId, line and oddsAmerican to check_slip. Never places a wager.
name: get_crowd_parlay
title: Read the crowd parlay
